official_attack_description: CTU-13 identifies Botnet-42 as a Neris botnet capture. Official CTU documentation states that each scenario PCAP is the botnet capture only; detailed bidirectional NetFlow files contain all traffic and labels.

detailed_biargus_documented: NetFlow labels for all traffic, including Background, Botnet, C&C Channels, and Normal

ground_truth_source: Official CTU-13 dataset documentation (Stratosphere Laboratory), section TYPE OF FILES AND DOWNLOAD.
alignment_basis: All 285 rows are consecutive windows from the supplied Botnet-42 PCAP; no packet-to-flow matching or behavioral inference was used.
limitations: No local JSON, HTML, README, timestamped activity annotation, or detailed biargus file is available for inspection.
The official source supports the capture-level Neris botnet label, not finer timestamped attack categories such as DDoS, scanning, or brute force.
This ground truth is single-class BOTNET; it is reliable for botnet-capture identification but cannot support a multi-class attack-type classifier by itself.
